description: Change the cook's own recipe or version. Use when the cook says "add more garlic to my version", "make mine private", "take it down" (unpublished: true; off Befana for everyone but them, reversible; a recipe others have cooked or saved can only come down this way), "use my photo for the cover", "undo that last change", or "I made it tonight, took about 50 minutes" (tested; ask for the time if they didn't say, never assume). Pass only what changes; ingredients or steps, if passed, are the complete new list. photo: only one the cook took, never generated, stock or found; even when asked, name the recipe and get a yes first. Before calling, show the cook the changed ingredients and steps and get a yes; never save silently. Every edit keeps a revision (restore_revision: n undoes edit n). Not the cook's? Use fork_recipe.

attached_photo.description: A JPG, PNG or WebP photo the cook attached in the chat, for the cover (or a step with photo.step). Convert HEIC/HEIF to one of those formats first. Change publication status (unpublished) in a separate call, never together with a photo. ChatGPT fills in this file object when the cook attaches a picture; don't type a link here (a link goes in photo.image_url). The same rules as photo: only a photo the cook took of this dish; name the recipe and where it goes and get the cook's yes first; it goes through the photo check and replaces the current cover.

download_url.description: The host's temporary download link for the attached file; the host fills this in

file_id.description: The host's id for the file; the host fills this in

chef_note.description: The chef's note, up to 500 characters: a sentence or two in the cook's words on what makes the recipe theirs. Only what the cook said; never write one for them.

key.description: Short tag steps use, e.g. "flour". When omitted: an ingredient already in the recipe keeps its key (match by item), a new one takes the tag your steps use for it if that tag is its name ("nutritional_yeast") or last word ("yeast"), else the last word of item.

qty.description: Amount, e.g. 1.5 or "1 1/2". Use 0 for 'to taste'.

unit.description: tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz, qt, oz, lb, g, kg, ml, l, clove, can, slice, sprig, bunch, head, stick, each, or empty

photo.description: A photo the cook took of this dish: the cover, or a step with step. Pass image_url or image_base64. Never a generated, stock or found-online picture. Asking for it isn't the yes: first tell the cook which recipe and where ("I'll set this photo as the cover of <title>. OK?") and call only after they say yes. It goes through Befana's photo check (a cover needs daylight and at least 1200 px on the long side); a refusal says what to fix and nothing changes. It replaces the current cover, a placeholder illustration included. If you can't pass the file, the cook can use "Add a photo" on the recipe page. Change publication status (unpublished) in a separate call, never together with a photo.

content_type.description: The file's type, e.g. image/jpeg; Befana reads it from the bytes

image_base64.description: The photo file itself as base64, for assistants that can read the cook's file: JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 3 MB (bigger: pass image_url)

image_url.description: A public https link to the cook's photo (a share link, or the host's download link for a file the cook attached)

step.description: Put the photo on this step (1 is the first) instead of the cover

restore_revision.description: Undo: put the recipe back to how it was before edit n (see get_recipe's revisions). Other fields you pass apply on top.

show_counts.description: Whether the page shows "cooked N times · shared N times" once there are enough cooks (#46); default on. false hides them

slug.description: The cook's recipe or version to change

body.description: Step text with amounts as tags: {flour}, a portion {butter:1/2}, oven temp in °F {t:375}

tip.description: A short pointer shown under the step, up to 140 characters: "The batter should look lumpy; don't overmix."

summary.description: One or two sentences on what makes it good

minutes.description: How long it took, start to finish, in minutes

tested.description: Mark the recipe tested: the cook says they cooked it themselves and timed it. Ask the cook ("Have you cooked this? About how long did it take, start to finish?") and pass only what they say; never assume it, never estimate the minutes, and never mark a recipe tested because you drafted, imported or adapted it. null clears the mark. Shown as "Tested by the cook · 45 min" and counted as one timed cook.

unpublished.description: true takes the recipe off Befana for everyone but the cook (the link stays theirs, nothing is lost, their lists and plans still open it); false puts it back. Not an edit: no revision. Confirm first, like any change

name: update_recipe

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Befana suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Befana suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

photo.description: Only when photo or attached_photo was passed

from_attachment.description: Present when the photo came in as attached_photo (a file the cook attached in the chat, #263)

note.description: What would make the photo better, when there's something

replaced_placeholder.description: True when it took the place of a generated placeholder illustration

reused.description: True when it was the cook's photo already on Befana, used again

tier.description: Befana's photo check: verified, acceptable or needs_work

url.description: The processed photo (Befana's own copy, metadata stripped)

restored.description: The revision that was restored, when restore_revision was passed

revision.description: The edit count after this change; update_recipe({ restore_revision: revision }) undoes it

show_counts.description: Whether the page shows public cook and share counts (#46)

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

unpublished.description: Off Befana for everyone but the cook (#171); update_recipe({ unpublished: false }) puts it back

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

visibility.description: private = just for the cook (out of search, the sitemap and the original's list of variations)

title: Change the cook's own recipe or version
